content: Malongi hana thandu ya mongu
Amana tangwa kámona milumba-lumba mya batu, wátombuka ku mongu, amana buna kázakala, balonguki bandi bábwesuka kwena yandi
amana mu kukangula munwa wandi, wáyandika kubalonga bwabu:
Mamboti ma kyedika

content.text: «Kyesi kwena bana bena baphutu mu kitembu,
mukuma Kipfumu kya mazilu kyenina kwena bawu!
Kyesi kwena bana benina yi nzala yi kihwinya kya masonga,
Kyesi kwena bana bisi yukila bakwawu kyadi,
Kyesi kwena bana benina yi mbundu ya hedila,
Kyesi kwena bana bisi yadisa ngemba,
mukuma bawu babátela bana ba Nzambi!
Kyesi kwena bana bisi nyokuna kikuma kya masonga,
mukuma Kipfumu kya mazilu kyenina kwena bawu!

content: Kyesi lwenina kyawu mu tangwa bisi lutukwana amana bisi lunyokuna amana bisi luhunina misamu mya mutindu yi mutindu kikuma kya meni.
Sangwalenu, amana kalenu mu kyesi, mukuma lufutu lwenu lwa lawu lwenina mu mazilu, mukuma, yi bwabuna phi bábanyokuna bambikudi bana balutekidila.»
Mungwa yi Kyesesi
«Benu lwenina mungwa wa tsi. Kaasi yukani mungwa wekina laku-laku, yi biki balenda vutwalawa mutomu? Wa phamba, weku hika mupfunu, ho kakulosawoku ku nzila batu badyatikisawa
«Benu lwenina kyesesi kya tsi. Mbanza mosi bátunga ha thandu ya mongu yifwaniku kuswamana
Amana bisiku lemisa mwinda ndangu bafidingawa ku tsya nzungu ya tuma; kaasi bisiwa sya ha muzanga, amana wulemi ndangu wayinika boosu bana benina mu nzu.
Bwabuna kyakenzudiki kyesesi kyenu ku thwala batu, ndangu bamona miza myenu mya bukheti amana bamuzatulaka Tata wenu wuna wenina mu mazilu.»
Malongi matadidi mitsiku
«Lubanzaku ni meni yisi zanga Mitsiku holo Bambikudi. Yisaku kikuma kya kuzanga, kaasi kulungisa.
Abwabuna, kikuma yiluzimbwadi: yi kuna dyalútila zilu yi tsi, ka kisona ku kimosi kya Mitsiku kyalúta, yi kuna mabwíla mambu moosu.

Disongidila wuna wakúlula keti mosi wa khunda muna mitsiku myami amana kalonga bwabuna kwena batu, bamútela wa khunda mu Kipfumu kya mazilu, kaasi wuna wazítisamya, walóngamya phi, yandi bamútela wa mbuta mu Kipfumu kya mazilu.
Mukuma, yiluzimbwadi, yuka ni masonga menu malutiku mana ma balongi ba mitsiku yi Bafwadisi, lwakótamwoku mu Kipfumu kya mazilu.»
Malongi matadidi khabu
«Lwáyuka ni bázimbula bwabu kwena bambuta: "Walendaku honda mvumbi wa khengu; wuna wahonda mvumbi wa khengu, bamunata ku pfundusu".
Kaasi meni, yiluzimbwadi bwabu: Wosu wuna wáyukila phangi wandi khabu, bulungi bamunata ku pfundusu. Amana wuna wazímbula kwena phangi wandi: "Zoba", bulungi bamunata ku thwala kimvuka kya mbuta
; amana wuna wázimbula kwena phangi wandi "Kilawu", bulungi bamulosa ku bilungi.
Kisongidila, yukani wubati kwenda hana kabu dyaku ku mesa ma kimenga, amana kwakuna, yuka wayubuka ni phangi waku kena yi kima kitadi ngeyi,
sisa hana kabu dyaku, kuna thwala ya mesa ma kimenga, amana wenda theti kuvutula ngemba yi phangi waku, kunima awisa hana kabu dyaku.
«Yidika tswatsu yi mbeni waku, buna lwenina yi yandi mu nzila ya nganda ya bazusi; kondilo, kakúlambula nana kwena zusi, amana zusi kwena phumbulu, amana bakutimbula mu boloku.
Abwabuna yikuzimbwadi: walúbukamwoku kedi yuka wufutiku yi kuna dikuta dya tsuka.»
Malongi matadidini mbongi
«Lwayuka ni bazimbula bwabu: "Watáku mbongi."
Kaasi meni, yiluzimbwadi: Wosu wuna watála mukhetu wa ngani mu phila ya kumukemba, wuti kedi mbongi yi yandi muna mbundu yandi.

Amana yukani disu dyaku dya kitata dyakubwisaka mu masumu, lokuladya amana losadya kyana yi ngeyi! Mukuma bwena mboti kwena ngeyi watotisa lwesi kitini kimosi kya lutu lwaku, kaasi bweku mboti ni balosa lutu lwosu ku bilungi.

Amana yukani koku dyaku dya kitata dyakusumunaka, zengadya, losadya kyana yi ngeyi; mukuma bwena mboti kwena ngeyi watotisa lwesi kitini kimosi kya lutu lwaku, kaasi bweku mboti ni balosa lutu lwaku lwosu ku bilungi.»
Malongi matadidi kufwa kwa longu
«Amana bazimbula bwabu: "Ni wuna wayámbula mukhetu wandi, kamuheka mukanda wa kufwa kwa longu.
Kaasi meni, yiluzimbwadi: Wosu wuna wayámbula mukhetu wandi, katula kusala kindumba, wumukitudi kita kya mbongi, amana wuna wakwéla mukhetu bayambudi ku longu, yandi phi mbongi kisi ta.»
Malongi matadidi ndefi
«Lwáyuka hika buna bázonza kwena bambuta: "Waléwulaku ndefi yaku, kaasi walúngisa ku thwala Pfumu mana wasila mu ndefi yaku."
Kaasi meni yiluzimbwadi lwesi ni ludyaku ndefi kyamakulu: keti ku zilu, kikuma kina kyenina kiti kya Kipfumu kya Nzambi;
keti ha tsi, kikuma mafu yi kidyatilu kyandi; keti ku Yelusalemi, kikuma yina yenina mbanza ya Kyamvu wa Mbuta.
Wadyáku ndefi keti mu mutwa waku, mukuma walendaku balumuna lusuki lumosi mu katoki kondilo mu kaphindi.
Amana yambula nzonzidi yenu yakala: yukani "abwabuna", "abwabuna", ho "loni", "loni"; mana bisikwa yika, kwena kiphidi-mutu misi tuka.»
Kuvutula mbela
«Lwáyuka ni bázimbula bwabu: "Disu muna disu amana dinu muna dinu
Kaasi meni, yiluzimbwadi: Luvutulaku mbela kwena mbeni. Honi mutu kakuta mbata ku tama dya kitata, mubalwamina hika dikwawu.
Amana yuka mutu wuzodi kakunatisa mukanu ndangu kalenga tambula kikutu kyaku, muyambula katambula hika muzaka
waku.
Amana yukani mutu kakulundika mu kusala funda dya thambi, ngeyi fwokula mu mbala zodi.
Kwena wuna wusi kulomba, hana, amana kwena wuna wutondi kulefwa kima kwena ngeyi, wuhungaku.»
Tonda dya bambeni
«Lwáyuka ni bázimbula bwabu: "Watónda khunda waku, amana waménga mbeni waku."
Kaasi meni, yiluzimbwadi: Tondenu bambeni benu amana lombilenu kikuma kya bana bisi lunyokuna.

Bwabuna lwakítwakila bana ba Tata wenu wuna wenina mu mazilu. Kikuma kisi lubula tangwa kikuma kya batu ba mbi yi batu ba mboti, amana kisi nokisa mvula kikuma kya batu ba masonga yi batu bakonda masonga.
Mukuma, yukani lwatondaka lwesi bana bisi lutonda, khi ndandu lwatámbula? Bakalaki ba phaku bisi bwoku hanga bwabuna phila mosi
Amana yukani benu lwahanaka mboti kwena baphangi benu lwesi, khi kima lwisi sala kya ngituka? Baphani bawu phi bisi bwoku hanga bwabuna phila mosi?
Disongidila, lwakala balungila bwosu kenina Tata wenu, wa ku zilu, walungila.»

footnotes.text: Mungwa wisi yidika bima. Wawu wisi hana mutomu wa kitoku ku bisaka amana wisi sadisa ndangu bisaka bizanganaku. Phila mosi, bakwikidi bisi yidika tsi yi batu bana bisi zingilamwa, mu kuzinga bwosu kalombibwa Nzambi. Bisi sadisa phi batu ndangu bazanganaku.

Yesu kabafwanikisa balonguki bandi yi mwini. Kyesesi kimosi kyisi twa kikuma kya bana benina mu phipha yi kubasongila nzila ya bawu. Phila mosi, balonguki ba Yesu bafwana kusongila nzila yina yisi nata kwena Nzambi kikuma kya batu bana bena mu phipha ya kitembu.

«Kimvuka kya mbuta» kina bisi tela ni Sanedeni, bisikya bongila hanga nganda ya mbuta ya basadi ba Nzambi ba Bayuta. Bapfumu ba bayuta makumi tsambwadi bakalaya tala, kaka banganga Nzambi yi balongi ba mitsiku yi bambuta ba dibundu bakala muna. Pfumu wa mbuta muna nganda meni kakala mbuta wa banganga Nzambi.

Mu nzila yayi yi yina yilandi, Yesu kasadidi bitini bya lutu bina thwisi sadila tangwa thwisi sumuka. Kasadila koku dya kitata yi disu dya kitata hanga bidimbu mu kusongila mana thwisi sala yi mana thwisi tala. Tangwa kazimbula ni tufwani kukatula koku dyetu dya kitata holo disu dyetu dya kitata, kazola kuzimbula ni twafwana kusya ngolu mu kubwisa masumu.
Mambu mama básonikama phi mu bulunda bwa khulu. Yuka watanga mukanda wa Kulonga 19:21
«Kikutu» wena mbandu ya muledi wa batu bana bafwana kuzengila mukanu. Kuyika kima kubati songila lutondu kwena mutu wambi.

Bakalaki ka phaku bababwisa kwena banduku ba bawu Bayuta kikuma kya mambu matatu: 1. Matangwa ma lawu bakala bonga makuta hana thandu ya makuta mana bazenga kikuma kya phaku, bakala swekama kikuma kya bawu meni amana bakala kituka bamvwama. 2. Bakala sadila bapfumu ba bisi Loma bana bakala nyokuna batu. 3. Bwosu bakala mu kikhunda yi bisi Loma bana bakonda kala bayuta, bawu phi bakala bamona, mu mitsiku mya bawu, hanga «batu ba mvindu, kikuma bakalaku zitisa mutsiku wa bayuta wuna wa kudisemisa».
